title: Work Schedule Notes - Late Night Productivity Pattern
content:
Personal work pattern observations:

Most productive hours: 8 PM - 2 AM. This is when creative flow happens best - fewer distractions, quieter environment, better focus on design work.

Morning meetings (before 11 AM): Require significant recovery time and disrupt the previous night's sleep schedule. After early morning client calls, often need 2-3 hours to feel fully functional again, which cuts into prime afternoon work time.
